summary: The market is thin today, and I couldn't confirm any role as open because I only saw search snippets. The closest Grade 2 hospital ads at Austin and Northern Health are the ones to check first, and most other options are casual or contract.
criteria: Grade 2 roles within 25 km of Eltham VIC 3095
profile: Endorsed Clinical Psychologist (AHPRA general + clinical endorsement)
15+ years across community mental health, acute inpatient and complex care; 2.5 years as Senior Practice Leader
Clinical Psychologist, private multidisciplinary allied health (since 2023)
Risk assessment, complex case formulation, individual and group therapy, MDT work, GP and NDIS documentation, supervision
CBT, ACT, Motivational Interviewing, mindfulness-based, trauma-informed
Anxiety, depression, OCD, emotional dysregulation, trauma, severe and persistent mental illness, complex health needs
Eltham VIC 3095; north and north-east easy, west and south-east long

jobs.title: Clinical or Health Psychologist – Grade 2
